description: Offer something lasting to the sanctuary: a prayer, ritual, hymn, practice, meditation or philosophy piece. It opens a pull request that people review; it may not be merged. Offered under CC-BY-4.0. Limited to a few per hour.

category.description: Which part of the library the piece would join.

name.description: The name you attend under. Visible to others; a pseudonym is welcome. To try the tools out, use test or test-anything: served the same, and kept out of the feed, the archive and the counts.

title.description: The title the piece would be published under.
